projects.title: Smart Lockers Platform
projects.shortTagline: An independent control plane that separates business systems from locker and device orchestration.
projects.publicSummary: A platform-first Smart Lockers architecture that connects business systems to hardware through a reusable Laravel boundary, queued command processing, MQTT, and webhook callbacks.
projects.strongestCapability: Reusable device orchestration and command lifecycle

verifiedMetrics.label: Reusable platform
verifiedMetrics.context: Designed for multiple business applications and machine deployments.

projects.title: Warqah Store
projects.shortTagline: A production commerce platform engineered to keep orders, inventory, payments, and shipping dependable through high-activity sales operations.
projects.publicSummary: Warqah Store is a live commerce platform where backend reliability directly affects revenue, order integrity, stock accuracy, payment confirmation, shipping execution, and campaign operations. I joined the project before its public launch and took ownership of preparing the backend and infrastructure for production. This included reworking key queue-processing flows using Redis, configuring the production server, managing deployments and DevOps operations, and implementing the Bosta shipping and Fawaterk payment integrations. I continued owning the backend as the platform launched and grew through real commercial operations.
projects.strongestCapability: Queue-backed payment, inventory, and fulfillment consistency

projects.title: Your Obour Guide
projects.shortTagline: A founder-built Obour city guide spanning Laravel, Flutter, Next.js, geospatial discovery, media delivery, and release operations.
projects.publicSummary: Your Obour Guide is a founder-built city-discovery ecosystem created specifically for Obour and New Obour. I owned the product concept and strategy, logo and brand identity, user-experience direction, Laravel backend and admin platform, Flutter mobile application, Next.js public website, geospatial place-data pipeline, media infrastructure, production deployment, and store-release operations. This is not a client project.
projects.role: Software Engineer — Laravel, Flutter, Next.js, and design
projects.strongestCapability: End-to-end product, data, mobile, web, and release ownership

projects.title: Autopay EG
projects.shortTagline: A founder-built Egyptian payment automation platform that detects and matches Vodafone Cash and InstaPay transfers to merchant invoices.
projects.publicSummary:
Autopay EG is a founder-built Egyptian payment-automation SaaS that automates transfer detection, invoice matching, confirmation, and merchant notification. It supports Vodafone Cash and InstaPay through a combination of hosted invoices, Android payment-event ingestion, merchant APIs, webhooks, dashboards, and commerce integrations.

Buyers complete the payment in the external wallet application, while Autopay automates the merchant-side confirmation workflow. The product is best described as a merchant payment-detection and confirmation automation SaaS.
projects.role: Software Engineer — Laravel, Vue, Android, integrations, and design
projects.strongestCapability: Concurrency-safe payment-event matching and idempotent notification

verifiedMetrics.label: Payment automation platform
verifiedMetrics.context: Supports Vodafone Cash and InstaPay detection, matching, webhooks, and commerce integrations.

projects.title: NABD
projects.shortTagline: A founder-built messaging SaaS that evolved from a public API into a multi-service platform with native commerce integrations.
projects.publicSummary:
NABD is a founder-built, production messaging SaaS that connects a Laravel business and orchestration platform with independent WhatsApp and Telegram execution services.

It began as a reusable messaging API for external websites, then evolved into a multi-channel SaaS and later into native commerce integrations for Salla and Zid.

The system processes more than 5,000 real messages every week.
projects.role: Software Engineer — Laravel, Node.js, WhatsApp, Telegram, and integrations
projects.strongestCapability: Queue-driven channel services and tenant-scoped orchestration

projects.title: Wasfaty Smart Vending
projects.shortTagline: A production smart-vending platform that validates Wasfaty prescriptions and coordinates controlled medicine dispensing through connected machines.
projects.publicSummary: Wasfaty Smart Vending is an end-to-end healthcare smart-vending system. It validates Wasfaty prescriptions, applies eligibility and medicine rules, resolves machine and stock availability, authorizes controlled dispensing, and reconciles physical outcomes through machine callbacks. The healthcare application uses the separate Smart Lockers platform for hardware execution, so the medical workflow and the machine-control layer stay cleanly separated.
projects.strongestCapability: Reliable reconciliation across healthcare APIs and physical dispensing

verifiedMetrics.label: Production use
verifiedMetrics.context: Real prescription-to-dispensing transactions under production conditions.

projects.title: Alzahaby Loyalty App
projects.shortTagline: A QR-powered loyalty and rewards platform connecting Alzahaby customers with product points and redeemable rewards.
projects.publicSummary: Alzahaby Loyalty & Rewards App is a production customer loyalty and rewards platform built for an electrical-cable manufacturer. The system combines a Flutter customer app, a Laravel backend, and an administration dashboard to turn product interaction into a structured customer experience. Customers can scan supported QR or product codes, earn points through server-side validation, browse rewards, and submit redemption requests. The platform is distributed for iOS and Android and is designed to support ongoing product engagement rather than a one-time checkout flow.
projects.strongestCapability: Race-safe QR validation and points-ledger workflows

verifiedMetrics.label: Store distribution
verifiedMetrics.context: Verified App Store and Google Play listings.

projects.title: Riders Shopify & WordPress Integrations
projects.shortTagline: Production Shopify and WooCommerce integrations connecting merchants to Riders shipping operations in Kuwait.
projects.publicSummary: This project consists of two separate production integrations built for Riders, a shipping company in Kuwait: a Laravel-based embedded Shopify application and a standalone WooCommerce shipping plugin. Both connect merchant storefronts with Riders shipping operations while respecting the different lifecycle, authentication, webhook, checkout, and background-processing models of each commerce platform.
projects.strongestCapability: Platform-native shipment synchronization and failure recovery

projects.title: SIM Express
projects.shortTagline: A self-service telecom kiosk platform built to sell and activate stc SIM and eSIM services for Hajj-oriented customer journeys.
projects.publicSummary: SIM Express is a self-service telecom kiosk and operations platform built for SIM and eSIM sales and activation scenarios. I owned the backend architecture, the kiosk-facing REST API, the Filament operations dashboard, the stc integration layer, queue-based processing, and the deployment and DevOps work needed to prepare the system for handover. The platform coordinates inventory, activation, and operational monitoring across a multi-tenant backend while supporting seven kiosk hardware categories and recovery-oriented background processing. The product was designed around Hajj-oriented customer journeys and other high-demand telecom-service environments, but I do not claim a confirmed production launch or current live operation.
projects.strongestCapability: Recoverable activation and multi-peripheral hardware workflows

verifiedMetrics.label: Kiosk hardware categories
verifiedMetrics.context: SIM dispenser, fingerprint scanner, identity reader, payment terminal, printer, camera, and touchscreen.

projects.title: Tawfir
projects.shortTagline: A surplus-food marketplace enabling UAE restaurants to sell discounted dishes for scheduled customer pickup.
projects.publicSummary: Tawfir is a multi-role food marketplace designed for the UAE market. It lets restaurants list surplus dishes at discounted prices, while customers browse, order, and collect them during scheduled pickup windows. I designed and built the complete Laravel backend and web operations platform, including its modular architecture, REST APIs, administration and restaurant dashboards, marketplace workflows, payments, notifications, and access-control systems. The Flutter customer application was built by another developer and consumed the APIs I built. The project was completed and delivered to a private client, but it was not publicly launched.
projects.strongestCapability: Modular marketplace workflows across restaurants, orders, and payouts

verifiedMetrics.label: Private client delivery
verifiedMetrics.context: Backend and web platform delivered; public launch is not claimed.

projects.title: PDF Extractor
projects.shortTagline: A document extraction platform combining native PDF parsing, OCR fallback, queue processing, live SSE progress, and optional AI text cleanup.
projects.publicSummary: PDF Extractor is a private document-processing platform built for a client company. It accepts PDF and Word documents, extracts native text where possible, falls back to OCR for scanned pages, and optionally applies AI-assisted cleanup before presenting the final result in a Vue interface. I designed and built the complete product end to end, including the Laravel backend, the Vue frontend, the upload experience, asynchronous processing, live progress updates, and result delivery. It was deployed for internal use and was not released as a public SaaS product.
projects.strongestCapability: One observable pipeline for native extraction, OCR, and AI cleanup

verifiedMetrics.label: Document ingestion
verifiedMetrics.context: Native parsing with OCR fallback for scanned pages.

projects.title: PinoyAid
projects.shortTagline: A substantially rebuilt crowdfunding platform with campaign moderation, donation operations, withdrawals, administration, and multi-gateway payment integrations.
projects.publicSummary: PinoyAid was a private client crowdfunding platform that I substantially rebuilt and customized on top of an existing base. The work covered campaign creation and moderation, donation operations, gateway-driven payment flows, raised-amount and balance updates, withdrawals, administration, and client-specific customization. I added most of the payment integrations during the rebuild and delivered the platform as a completed client project. The source contains runtime implementations for multiple payment providers, but production activation and real transaction usage are not being claimed.

verifiedMetrics.label: Payment architecture
verifiedMetrics.context: Provider-specific redirect, capture, callback, and webhook flows.
